title: Entity Relationship Diagram — Prisma Schema (SQLite via libsql)
description: Core models for Better Auth + application data. Firebase/Firestore models (legacy) not shown.

nodes.label: **User**
nodes.description: id (PK), email (UK), password, role, name, image, emailVerified, createdAt, updatedAt

nodes.label: **LandlordProfile**
nodes.description: id (PK), userId (FK, UK), businessName, phone, whatsappNumber, nationalId, targetCampuses, estimatedProperties, status, reviewNote, consentGivenAt, consentVersion

nodes.label: **Listing**
nodes.description: id (PK), title, description, price, deposit, category, location, lat/lng, images, amenities, genderRestriction, hasWifi, hasWater, videoUrl, status, isVerified, landlordId (FK), userId (FK), university, distanceFromCampus

nodes.label: **Favorite**
nodes.description: id (PK), userId (FK), listingId (FK), createdAt — UK(userId, listingId)

nodes.label: **University**
nodes.description: id (PK), name, slug (UK), logoUrl, location, contactEmail, contactPhone, description, verified, adminUserId, status, foundedYear, studentCount

nodes.label: **Hostel**
nodes.description: id (PK), universityId (FK), name, location, description, hostelType, images, amenities, wardenName/Phone/Email, status

nodes.label: **HostelRoom**
nodes.description: id (PK), hostelId (FK), roomNumber, bedNumber, roomType, pricePerMonth/Semester/Year, status, currentOccupants, maxOccupants, occupancyPercentage, amenities, features, availableFrom/Until, bookingDeadline

nodes.label: **Apartment**
nodes.description: id (PK), name, location, description, address, lat/lng, amenities, images, agentId, ownerType, ownerName, contactEmail, contactPhone, status

nodes.label: **Room**
nodes.description: id (PK), apartmentId (FK), roomNumber, roomType, price, deposit, description, features, images, status, maxOccupants, squareMeters, availabilityDate

nodes.label: **Session** (Better Auth)
nodes.description: id (PK), userId (FK), token (UK), expiresAt, ipAddress, userAgent

nodes.label: **Account** (Better Auth)
nodes.description: id (PK), userId (FK), accountId, providerId, accessToken, refreshToken, scope, idToken, password — UK(providerId, accountId)

nodes.label: **VerificationToken** (Better Auth)
nodes.description: id (PK), identifier, token (UK), expiresAt — UK(identifier, token)
